In its city

Your building, among its real neighbours.

Pick a place and your building takes its spot in a paper model of the city.

Where a neighbour’s height is a guess, its top and its shadow are hatched. Type its real floor count and the hatch closes.

02
Sun and shade

Follow the sun across the year.

Sweep a day from dawn to dusk and watch the shadows swing across the roofs.

In Hyderabad, from mid May to early August, the noon sun stands in the north. North glass needs shading too, and the model shows where.

More detail
PREVIEW

03
Daylight

Light in every room.

Slide a floor out of the building like a drawer and see how far the daylight reaches.

Bright areas fill with colour and dim corners stay plain paper. Where low sun falls hard on desks or beds, a warm hatch marks the glare.

More detail
PREVIEW

04
Energy, bills and carbon

Where the energy goes, and what it costs.

One bar splits the year into cooling, lighting, equipment, fans, pumps, hot water and solar.

The total shows as a range beside a target, so you can see how sure we are. Bills follow the local tariff, month by month.

Codes and green ratings

Know where you stand before anyone asks.

One early pass against the energy codes and green ratings that apply to your plot.

Each line says where the design stands and how sure we are. Rating points show as likely, possible or unknown. A certificate still comes from an assessor.

Change one thing. Watch the rest move.
